variants.longDescription: The modern minimal living room is designed around restful negative space and a single accent. The L-shape sofa anchors the seating zone in genuine Italian top-grain leather, balanced by a walnut coffee table with brushed brass inlays. A wall-mounted modular TV unit with integrated cove lighting keeps storage hidden and sight lines clean. Acoustic linen drapes frame floor-to-ceiling glazing, while engineered oak flooring with a matte clear coat ties the palette together. The result is a calm, low-glare space ideal for evening conversation and weekend films, scaled for a 3BHK Worli residence.

variants.name: Modern Beige
variants.description: Same modern layout with warm beige fabric sofa variant.

hotspots.label: L-Shape Sofa (Beige)
hotspots.description: Premium beige fabric L-shape sofa.

variants.longDescription: The Modern Beige variant keeps the same architecture and lighting plan but swaps the leather sofa for a sand-toned performance fabric, dialling the room toward warmth and softness. Travertine-look porcelain replaces the oak floor, reflecting more light back into the space, while the TV unit moves to a fluted oak finish to play against the linen-wrapped walls. The brass hardware shifts to satin nickel, and a hand-knotted wool rug sits under the seating cluster. The plan suits clients who want a daytime-friendly room that photographs bright but still dresses up well in evening lamp-light.

variants.name: Contemporary
variants.description: A sleek contemporary take with matte grey upholstery and smoked-glass surfaces.
variants.longDescription: The contemporary variant trades warmth for a cooler, gallery-like calm: a low-profile boucle sofa in matte grey anchors the seating zone, paired with a smoked-glass and chrome coffee table. Clean-lined joinery and a restrained palette keep the room feeling current without chasing any one trend too hard.

variants.name: Industrial
variants.description: An industrial-loft take with exposed brick and blackened steel fixtures.
variants.longDescription: The industrial variant leans into exposed structure: a feature wall in raw brick, blackened steel shelf brackets, and factory-style pendant lighting. Furniture stays low and utilitarian so the architecture keeps doing the talking.

variants.name: Traditional
variants.description: A traditional take in Chesterfield leather and emerald velvet accents.
variants.longDescription: The traditional variant is built around a tufted Chesterfield sofa in cognac leather, balanced by emerald velvet accent chairs and a dark hardwood floor. Detailed cornicing and warm brass fittings round out a room meant to feel established rather than trend-driven.

variants.name: Minimalist
variants.description: A minimalist take in whitewashed oak and matte white walls.
variants.longDescription: The minimalist variant strips the room back to essentials: whitewashed oak flooring, matte white walls, and a single low sofa with no visible hardware. Negative space is the feature, not an afterthought.

variants.name: Scandinavian
variants.description: A Scandinavian take in pale ash wood and wool textiles.
variants.longDescription: The Scandinavian variant favours light over mass: pale ash flooring, a wool-throw-draped sofa, and sheer linen curtains that let daylight carry the room. Hardware stays soft brass, kept deliberately understated against the pale palette.

variants.name: Modular Classic
variants.description: A fully modular kitchen with premium fittings and integrated appliances.

hotspots.label: Kitchen Counter
hotspots.description: Quartz countertop with integrated sink and hob.

hotspots.label: Material Details
hotspots.description: All cabinets use marine-grade plywood with soft-close hinges.

variants.longDescription: A working chef's kitchen built on a 1200 mm modular grid, with a deep peninsular counter that doubles as a casual breakfast bar. Tall larders flank a built-in oven and microwave column, and the upper cabinets carry a continuous LED reveal so the splashback never sits in shadow. A single-bowl undermount sink is paired with a dual-flow pull-out tap, and the hob is induction with an integrated downdraft extractor. Soft-close hardware throughout keeps the room library-quiet during evening prep, while marine-grade ply and PU lacquer survive Mumbai's humid monsoon months without warping.

variants.name: Minimal Stone
variants.description: A clean, light-filled entry with honed stone flooring and a slim console.
variants.longDescription: The foyer sets a quiet, uncluttered tone before the rest of the home unfolds. A slim marble-top console with brass legs holds keys and mail, while an arched brass-framed mirror bounces daylight from the front door deeper into the plan. Honed limestone flooring in a pale neutral keeps the entry feeling larger than its footprint, and a single pendant overhead avoids visual clutter.

variants.name: Signature Walnut
variants.description: An indulgent primary suite in deep walnut and brushed brass.
variants.longDescription: The primary suite is scaled for a signature-tier fit-out: a king bed in linen upholstery sits against a walnut headboard wall, flanked by a full-height walk-in wardrobe with handleless shutters. A linen-upholstered bench closes the composition at the foot of the bed. Warm walnut tones and champagne brass hardware carry through from the living areas, keeping the whole 3BHK feeling considered rather than assembled room by room.

A cheerful cobalt-and-mustard accent wall and washable rug bring in color without competing with the toy storage wall, which keeps everything behind flush, fingerprint-resistant shutters.

variants.longDescription: The master bedroom is designed around calm, low-glare rest. An upholstered king bed anchors the room in soft linen, framed by a fluted oak headboard wall with integrated cove lighting. A full-height modular wardrobe keeps storage hidden behind handleless shutters, while matched bedside tables and a quiet pendant pair balance the composition. Engineered oak flooring with a matte clear coat ties the warm palette together, scaled for a 4BHK Ashok Nagar residence.
